Plot predictions

Source: R/kb_plot_predictions.R
kb_plot_predictions.Rd

Render a ggplot from a kb_predictions object (the output of a kb_predict_*() function).

Usage

kb_plot_predictions(
  predictions,
  ...,
  x = NULL,
  geom = c("pointrange", "bar"),
  log_axis = c("none", "y", "xy"),
  max_facets = 12L
)

Arguments

predictions

A kb_predictions object.

...

These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

x

A string naming the x-axis column, or NULL to choose it from the predictions.

geom

A string, one of "pointrange" (points with intervals) or "bar" (columns from zero with intervals), for predictions not drawn as a curve.

log_axis

A string, one of "none" (linear axes), "y" (log-scaled y-axis), or "xy" (log-scaled x- and y-axes).

max_facets

A whole number capping the facet panels drawn; if the grouping has more groups, the first max_facets are shown with a warning. Use Inf to disable.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The x-axis, facets, and geometry are chosen from the predictions: predictions over a grid of predictor values (as from kb_new_data()) are drawn as a line and compatibility-interval ribbon, and others as points or columns with intervals. The result is a ggplot that can be extended with +, for example to add the raw data as a layer.

See also

Other prediction functions: autoplot.kb_predictions(), kb_new_data(), kb_predict_biomass_canopy(), kb_predict_biomass_in_situ(), kb_predict_carbon(), kb_predict_cover_calibration(), kb_predict_mean_weight(), kb_predict_nitrogen(), kb_predict_size(), kb_predict_weight(), kb_predict_wetdry(), predict.kb_fit_carbon(), predict.kb_fit_cover_calibration(), predict.kb_fit_nitrogen(), predict.kb_fit_size(), predict.kb_fit_weight(), predict.kb_fit_wetdry()

Examples

fit <- fit_weight_sim_nereo

# Allometric curve by site (ribbon):
kb_predict_weight(fit, kb_new_data(fit, by = "site")) |>
  kb_plot_predictions()


# Add the raw data as a layer:
kb_predict_weight(fit, kb_new_data(fit)) |>
  kb_plot_predictions() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(diameter_mm, weight_kg),
    data = data_weight_sim_nereo,
    alpha = 0.3
  )


# Expected size by site (pointrange):
kb_predict_size(
  fit_size_sim_nereo,
  kb_new_data(fit_size_sim_nereo, by = "site")
) |>
  kb_plot_predictions()


# Weight at a reference diameter by site (pointrange, sites on the y-axis):
kb_predict_weight(fit, kb_new_data(fit, by = "site", diameter_mm = 30)) |>
  kb_plot_predictions() +
  ggplot2::coord_flip()


# Canopy biomass by year (columns):
kb_predict_biomass_canopy(
  fit_cover_calibration_sim_nereo,
  data_survey_canopy_sim_nereo,
  pool_by = "year"
) |>
  kb_plot_predictions(geom = "bar")


# Allometric curve on log-log axes:
kb_predict_weight(fit, kb_new_data(fit)) |>
  kb_plot_predictions(log_axis = "xy")


# Cover curve on log-log axes, over positive cover values:
cover_fit <- fit_cover_calibration_sim_nereo
kb_predict_cover_calibration(
  cover_fit,
  kb_new_data(cover_fit, cover = 10^seq(-3, 0, length.out = 30))
) |>
  kb_plot_predictions(log_axis = "xy")
